_说明: 开场过场动画 v1 的英文（格式同 en.json）。旁白的英文就是方案 docs/design/开场过场动画-方案-v1.md 里那 7 句，按中文的分行在同样的位置拆开（一行一句，拼回去和方案逐字相同）。

lines.这是一个由走兽飞禽组成的江湖。: This is a jianghu of beasts and birds.
lines.门派林立，各怀绝技。: Sects rise everywhere, each with its own art.
lines.胜负，往往只在一招之间。: A duel is often won or lost in a single move.
lines.山上曾有一座门派。: Once, a sect stood on this mountain.
lines.身法轻灵，专在危难时护人脱险。: Light of foot, it came to the rescue of those in danger.
lines.山下的人，至今还记得它。: The folk below still remember it.
lines.直到那一年，藏经阁塌了半座。: Until that year, when half the Scripture Library fell.
lines.弟子们一个接一个，下了山。: One by one, the disciples went down the mountain.
lines.如今，山门破旧，只剩三个人守着。: Now the gate is old and worn, and only three remain.
lines.一位不爱提起过去的师父；: A Master who never speaks of the past;
lines.一个嘴欠却护短的师兄——: a Senior Brother with a sharp tongue and a soft heart—
lines.他的故事，从一个漏雨的早晨开始。: His story begins one rainy morning.
